changelog: Fixed active month selection so June roster/monthly stats do not switch to empty July after confirmation
Roster and Calendar keep showing the active published month during In flight/current duty states
Stopped old due notifications from being shown again on normal app startup refresh
Improved notification timing by checking registration windows in the departure airport timezone
Prevented gate/stand assignment and gate notifications for same-duty turnaround return sectors
Replaced Calendar List/Month purple buttons with a compact blue/graphite segmented control
Moved TAS/Tashkent out of the normal layover pool and added future special Thursday/Sunday rules
Refreshed login screen styling with a cleaner corporate aviation look
